episodes.synopsis: On his return from a trip to Japan, Oscar Claudel brings a young girl named Yune to work at his metalworks shop, the Enseignes du Roy.
episodes.title: Entrance

episodes.synopsis: Yune eats her first French breakfast and attempts to hide her dislike of cheese! Claude, Oscar's grandson, takes Yune shopping.
episodes.title: Cheese

episodes.synopsis: Claude becomes inspired by Yune with an idea for a sign for a nearby music shop. Later, they find the owners of Yune's kimono.
episodes.title: Japanese Labyrinth

episodes.synopsis: Alice, the youngest of the upper-class Blanche family, becomes interested in Yune and wants her to stay with her, but Yune has made a promise to the Claudels.
episodes.title: Water Light

episodes.synopsis: Claude scolds Yune for her kindness, which is taken advantage of by a boy who steals from the shop.
episodes.title: Lost

episodes.synopsis: Alice pays a visit to Yune at Oscar's shop and invites her over for a photograph. There, Yune learns of a past between Alice's sister Camille and Claude
episodes.title: Crinoline

episodes.synopsis: Yune faints from a fever, which fills Claude with guilt for scolding her earlier. He receives help from Alice and her doctor to cure Yune.
episodes.title: Skylight

episodes.synopsis: A tea party at the Blanche's brings Claude and Camille together, while Alice shows Yune the nursery where she grew up.
episodes.title: A Child's Room

episodes.synopsis: Claude speaks about the past with Camille when they used to play together in the Blanche's family garden.
episodes.title: Secrets

episodes.synopsis: Oscar spends time with Yune and Alice. He shows off a slide projector that reminds Alice of her parts of her life back in Japan.
episodes.title: Phantasmagoria

episodes.synopsis: Alice invites Yune to an exhibition at the Grand Magasin, but Claude opposes and makes other plans for them. Yune shares more about her family in Japan.
episodes.title: A Prayer

episodes.synopsis: Yune goes out to search for a lost black cat and gets lost, which worries Claude who cannot find her.
episodes.title: Cat on the Roof
